body:
**Research backlog — agent-owned; no separate user review required.**

Eight existing Matchms/OHIF pairs recovered; Scanpy remained timed out at 1,200 seconds. OpenMS acquisition recovered, not task generation. MMseqs bootstrap comparison and general timeout policy remain unmeasured.

A #67 control also completed before owner-worker cleanup was blocked by insufficient memory headroom. Accounting reserves do not reserve a physical cleanup slot; preserving that slot or keeping the original allocation alive needs assessment. [Cleanup scheduling diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/29#issuecomment-6424930481).

No new execution is admitted by this status update. Overall findings, costs and remaining work are summarized in epic #33; PR #63 is the consolidated implementation review. Original execution records remain in prior comments and linked research artifacts.

[Matchms results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/188091eb/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json) · [OHIF results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a090c9ce/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-control-results.json) · [Scanpy results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fea436b3/experiments/29-runtime-limits/scanpy-control-results.json) · [OpenMS evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/875eab80/experiments/29-runtime-limits/openms-checkout-readback-001.json) · [Accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fea436b3/experiments/29-runtime-limits/campaign-accounting.json) · [Scanpy cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fea436b3/experiments/29-runtime-limits/scanpy-recorded-cleanup-readback-001.json)
